verdict.rationale: Rootly's 'Workflows' engine matches the runbook-automation story closely: workflows trigger automatically on incident events and execute structured actions like creating Slack/Teams channels, notifying stakeholders, filing tickets, and starting retros (docs-16/17/29/34/41/45), and AI SRE/AWS connectors provide automated diagnostics during incidents (docs-59/60). Missing for 10: explicit 'runbook' terminology/attachment concept (Rootly frames this as 'Workflows' not runbooks), explicit task-assignment action documentation, and independent hands-on confirmation that automated diagnostics run reliably in production.
